comments.en: All DTOs annotated with [MapFrom] use the source generator path (zero reflection) and support full NativeAOT publishing.

comments.zh: DTO carries [MapFrom], so runtime takes the source-generated path (AOT-safe); the IL warning is only the conservative signal from Mapper.Map's public UC annotations, known safe
